payrollRunsSubtitle: One run a month: calculate from attendance, check, approve, then record the bank transfer. The person who prepares a run does not approve it, and the approver does not pay it.
headOfficeAndStaffNoBranch: (head office, and staff with no branch)
runDraftHint: The run starts as a draft. Calculating it reads the month’s attendance from Staff & HR — paid days, loss of pay (half days count 0.5), night shifts, on-call duties, call-backs and overtime — and works out every payslip.
statutoryVerifyWarning: The statutory rules (PF, ESI, professional tax, LWF, income tax) are the shipped defaults and have not been checked by the hospital yet. Verify them in Statutory rules before paying real salaries.
noPayrollRunsHint: Put staff on salary structures first, then start this month’s run.
payslipsSubtitle: Each employee’s pay for the month with how it was worked out. Loss of pay can be corrected, with a reason, until the run is approved; every correction is audited.
lopCorrectedFootnote: * LOP corrected by payroll (the attendance figure and the reason are on the payslip).
attendanceLopHint: Attendance gives {{days}} day(s) of loss of pay for {{month}} (half days count 0.5). Correct it when attendance is wrong — the change and its reason go into the audit log.
lopReasonPlaceholder: Absence on the 12th was approved casual leave
shownOnPayslipHint: Leave blank for the kind’s name.
recordPaymentSubtitle: Record the transfer once the bank has processed the salary file. Loan instalments are booked against the loans now, and staff can see their payslips.
calculateAgainMessage: Payslips are worked out again from today’s attendance, salaries and loans. LOP corrections and lines added by hand are kept.
approvedSuccess: Approved. Accounts can now pay it.
sodApproveWarn: You prepared this run; someone else approves it.
sodPayWarn: You prepared or approved this run; someone else records the payment.
salaryStructuresSubtitle: Earnings and deductions, each a fixed amount, a percentage of basic / gross / CTC or the balance of the gross — never a formula. Staff are put on a structure from a date, with their own overrides.
deleteStructureMessage: Only a structure nobody has been on can be deleted; otherwise switch it off.
noSalaryStructuresHint: A structure lists the earnings and deductions, each as a fixed amount, a percentage or the balance of the gross.
bulkAssignHint: Each keeps the gross on their salary record; personal overrides can be added one by one afterwards.
addInStaffHr: add it in Staff & HR or here
savedArrearsNotice: Saved. Months already paid since then get arrears in the next run.
calcBoxFootnote: Full month, no loss of pay, before night / on-call / overtime pay. Cost to the hospital {{cost}} (state {{state}}).
effectiveFromHint: A later date keeps the old one for the months before it.
incomeTaxMonthHint: Blank: projected from the tax slabs. Set it from the employee’s declaration.
noneStructureAsIs: None — the structure as it is.
loanRecoverHint: {{instalment}} comes off the payslip each month from {{startMonth}} until {{amount}} is recovered. Instalments are booked when a run is paid.
loanBalanceFootnote: {{instalment}} a month from {{startMonth}}; about {{left}} instalment(s) left.
noRecoveriesYet: None yet — the first is booked when a payroll run that recovers it is paid.
loansSubtitle: Staff loans and salary advances, recovered from pay in monthly instalments.
name: Name
meantForHint: A hint when assigning; anyone can be put on any structure.
allowanceRatesTitle: Allowance and overtime rates for this structure
allowanceRatesSubtitle: Blank: uses the hospital defaults in Statutory rules.
statutoryRulesSubtitle: The rates and slabs payroll works by. They ship as defaults — the hospital must check them against the current notifications before paying real salaries; any change clears the check.
markVerifiedPlaceholder: EPFO / ESIC circulars and the Karnataka PT schedule, October 2026
shippedDefaultsWarning: These are the shipped defaults (EPFO 12% with the ₹15,000 wage ceiling, ESIC 0.75% / 3.25% up to ₹21,000, state PT and LWF slabs, new-regime income tax for FY {{year}}). Nobody at the hospital has verified them yet.
restrictToCeiling: Contribute on wages up to the ceiling only (EPS is always on the ceiling)
esiSubtitle: Covered while the monthly gross is within the ceiling; once covered, till the contribution period ends
allowancesOvertimeSubtitle: Defaults for every structure (a structure can set its own rates)
overtimeHourlyHint: Hourly = (basic + DA) ÷ pay days ÷ hours a day
separationOfDuties: Separation of duties: whoever prepares a run cannot approve it, and the approver cannot record its payment
leavingSubtitle: Worked out in the run of the month of the last working day
gratuityFormulaExplanation: Gratuity = {{factor}}/{{divisor}} × last (basic + DA) × years of service (a part-year over six months counts as a year), from {{minYears}} years (any service on death). Encashment = days × (basic + DA) ÷ {{encashDivisor}}. Notice recovery = days short × gross ÷ 30.
incomeTaxSubtitle: Monthly TDS = tax on the projected year’s salary ÷ 12; it can be set per employee on their assignment
marginalRelief: Marginal relief above the rebate limit
taxableIncomeUpTo: Taxable income up to (₹, blank = above)
surchargeAbove: Surcharge on taxable income above (₹) · rate %
ptSubtitle: The state of the employee’s branch, else the hospital’s state, else the default below
lwfSubtitle: Deducted only in the months listed
lastChangedBy: Last changed by {{by}}{{at}}. Every change is in the audit log.
exportsSubtitle: Files for the bank transfer and the PF, ESI and professional tax returns, made from an approved run. Cells that start with = + − @ are written as text, so a spreadsheet never runs them.
runNotApprovedYetNotice: This run is not approved yet. Only the salary register can be downloaded; the bank and statutory files come once it is approved.
encryptionNotice: Bank account numbers, UAN and ESI numbers are kept encrypted in Staff & HR and are written out only into these files. Every download is recorded in the audit log.
exportSkipped: {{count}} employee(s) left out — bank account, UAN or ESI number missing in Staff & HR.
aboutBankCsv: Beneficiary, bank, IFSC, account number and net pay for everyone paid by bank transfer — a plain CSV most banks’ bulk upload accepts.
aboutBankHdfc: The HDFC Bank ENet bulk layout (I = within HDFC, N = NEFT), no header row. Check the column layout with your bank before the first upload.
aboutPfEcr: EPFO ECR text file: UAN, wages (gross, EPF, EPS, EDLI), contributions and NCP days, separated by #~#, in whole rupees.
aboutEsi: ESIC monthly contribution sheet: IP number, days paid, wages, reason code for zero days and last working day.
aboutPt: Professional tax by state and slab, then each employee — for the state return.
aboutRegister: Every payslip on one line: attendance, each earning and deduction, employer contributions and bank details. Opens in Excel.

payslipDrawer.payDaysFormula: Each fixed earning × {{payDays}} ÷ {{baseDays}}. Present {{present}}, half days {{halfDays}}, absent {{absent}}, leave {{leave}}
payslipDrawer.projectedDays: ; {{count}} day(s) still to come counted as paid
payslipDrawer.fnfTitle: Full and final settlement — last working day {{date}}
payslipDrawer.lopSaved: LOP saved; the payslip is recalculated.

runDrawer.sodPreparedNote: You prepared this run (calculated it or changed a payslip), so someone else has to approve it.
runDrawer.notPaidCount: {{count}} employee(s) not paid in this run
runDrawer.andMore: …and {{count}} more. Assign them a structure in Salary structures.
runDrawer.lopThisMonth: Loss of pay this month: {{count}} day(s) in all.
runDrawer.notCalculatedHint: Calculate to work out every payslip from this month’s attendance.
runDrawer.paymentRecorded: Payment recorded. Staff can now see their payslips.

structureModal.changesApplyNote: Changes apply from the next calculation. Months already paid are not reworked; to pay a raise for past months, give the employee a new assignment from that date (arrears follow).

runScopeHint: One run a month for the whole hospital, or one per branch.

overview.noRun: No month has been calculated yet
